claim: Sri Lanka's plastic restrictions were not merely announced: the Central Environmental Authority reports island-wide enforcement activity in 2023, including 7,236 raids across the covered plastic regulations, 197 detected violations and 5,417.4 kg of illegal polythene food wrappers seized with Consumer Affairs Authority support.
bounded_by: The 2023 totals aggregate enforcement of multiple plastic regulations and do not isolate compliance with the October-2023 ban. Enforcement activity does not establish population-wide compliance, reduced leakage, or ecological improvement.
notes: Run20 closes the narrow Run15 question 'does measurable enforcement evidence exist?' while leaving environmental effectiveness and regulation-specific compliance open.
